abstract_sentences.text: Event cameras are biologically inspired sensors garnering significant attention from both industry and academia.

Mainstream methods favor frame and voxel representations, which reach a satisfactory performance while introducing time-consuming transformations, bulky models, and sacrificing fine-grained temporal information.

Alternatively, Point Cloud representation demonstrates promise in addressing the mentioned weaknesses, but it has limited scalability in abstracting features of higher spatial resolution and longer temporal sequence events.
In this paper, we propose a Scalable Network named SECNet to leverage Event Cloud representation.

evidence.anchor: propose a Scalable Network named SECNet

abstract_sentences.text: SECNet integrates polarity at the structural level by innovating the Event-based Group and Sampling module rather than only at the input level.

evidence.anchor: integrates polarity at the structural level

abstract_sentences.text: To accommodate the surge in the number of events, SECNet embraces feature extraction in the frequency domain via the Fourier transform.

evidence.anchor: frequency domain via the Fourier transform

abstract_sentences.text: This approach not only substantially extinguishes the explosion of Multiply Accumulate Operations but also effectively abstracts spatio-temporal features.

evidence.anchor: extinguishes the explosion of Multiply Accumulate Operations

abstract_sentences.text: We conducted extensive experiments on ten event-based datasets, and substantiate the scalability, effectiveness, and efficiency of SECNet.
Our code will be available at: https://github.com/rhwxmx/SECNet_ICML.

abstract_structure.strongest_claim_location: Sentence 8 claims scalability, effectiveness and efficiency after announcing ten datasets; no numeric result is supplied.

evidence.anchor: overall computational flow of the SECNet pipeline

method_moves.current_answer: Eq. 3–7 串起 G&S、SFA、AGG、TFA、RES 与状态更新。
α 对四坐标缩放后 FPS，下采样一半 events。
用 feature distance 而非坐标构造邻域。
group 坐标均值、坐标/特征拼接、标准化和 centroid feature 拼接。

evidence.anchor: capturing the contextual relationships among a large number of events

method_moves.current_answer: 大量事件同时带来上下文抽取与能耗瓶颈。
给出 DFT、inverse DFT 和 learnable filter 的 FFT/Hadamard 流程。
SFA 处理 group 内空间/拓扑特征，复杂度由 O(D_i²) 变为 O(D_i log²(D_i))。
TFA 在聚合后的时间维捕获 global/short-term interactions。
AGG 以邻居维 soft attention 得到 F_Ai。

evidence.anchor: LSTM and attention are not adept

method_moves.current_answer: 把 TFA 与 LSTM/attention 的长依赖与复杂度做对照。
RES 在末端增强高层 feature hierarchy。
最后接 classifier/regressor，Figure 3 展示 mean/max pooling。

method_summary.input: chronologically ordered Event Cloud EC with shape [T0,4], Min-Max normalized; it is not permutation invariant.
method_summary.stage_configuration: Appendix C specifies 3 loops, Conv1D embedding 4→64, feature dimensions 64→132→268→540, and halved groups/centroids.

components.G&S: D-FPS coordinate scaling α + EF-KNN feature-distance grouping + CES mean coordinate update + standardization/concatenation
components.SFA: Fourier/Hadamard filtering across group feature/channel dimension for local spatial/topological features
components.TFA: global Fourier filtering over chronological event/time dimension
components.heads: mean/max pooling followed by classifier or regressor

method_summary.stage_flow: Embed → [G&S → SFA → AGG → TFA → RES]×m → update EC/F → mean⊕max → classifier/regressor.
method_summary.complexity_claim: SFA is described as O(D_i log²(D_i)) versus MLP O(D_i²); at D=540 the text claims factor 60 per operation and up to 20× in the constructed network.
method_summary.algorithm_location: Algorithm 1 is in Appendix H p. 15; §3.2.3 incorrectly points to Section G.

claim_closure.claim: Point Cloud 的 polarity/邻域/长序列问题需要结构性修复

claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 9、Table 10 和 Appendix I/Table 13 支持扩展与硬件效率，但 ECNet 多数数据集精度更高。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion 只回收 frequency-domain；Appendix G/J/I 补充成本。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文先用按时间排序的 Event Cloud 避免 frame/voxel 转换，再以 D-FPS、EF-KNN、CES 将 polarity 和 feature-aware topology 纳入 G&S，随后用 SFA/TFA 的 Fourier filtering 处理大规模空间/长时事件，最后以十数据集、三任务、事件数扩展和 FPGA 对照支撑“可扩展且轻量”。[pp. 1–9]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题缺口、Event Cloud 定义、Eq. 1–17、Figure 3/4、Table 1–10、核心模块消融和 FPGA headline；不含 seed、完整命令、功耗或公平的跨基线预算。[pp. 4–9]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录移动表示对比、数据 split、具体维度/centroid、服务器和 FPGA 补充、Algorithm 1、runtime lookup、SFA 替代及 pose 可视化；迁移保持主文节奏，却使复现细节和效率—精度 trade-off 需要跨页拼接。[pp. 13–18]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先用 Figure 2 把表示差异视觉化，再用 Figure 3 把组件链显式化，随后用 Table 2–7 按任务和硬件递进，Table 8–10 做组件/事件数/FPGA 决策检验；“表示→机制→任务→成本”顺序易于跟踪。[pp. 2–9]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有形式理论保证、seed/不确定性、compute-matched baseline 或真实 edge deployment；Appendix I 显示多数数据集 ECNet 精度更高，而正文 5%/16%/27% 百分比口径与 cross-reference 也不完全闭合。[pp. 7–9、16、18]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 写轻量表示学习论文时，先固定 raw data 保留规则、时间顺序、split 与输入预算，再让每个结构组件对应一个删除/替代/扩展对照，最后把 Accuracy/MPJPE 与参数、GMAC、runtime 放在同一决策表中；将完整维度、硬件和伪代码移入附录时，必须保持正文调用和编号一致。[pp. 4–9、13–18]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则只能提升“机制—测量—成本”闭环，不能把单一事件相机、固定十数据集与单点测量外推成所有 vision tasks、跨传感器泛化、低功耗 deployment 或 privacy 结论。[pp. 6–9、14–18]
final_judgment.evidence: Key evidence: Figure 2 p. 2; Figure 3 p. 3; Table 8 p. 8; Appendix I/Table 13 pp. 16/18.
